svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/ripple/ - Ripple and noise, with load
When it is seen: when the measurement file has the load currents (conditions): the program
What to draw: like image 10, but with in addition the electronic load, connected to the output
of the power supply (+ to +, − to −) with short, thick cables.
Details: the load cables drawn thick and different from the probe, so that they are not
confused; the probe stays on the capacitor, not on the load.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
